notes.title: Interlude Patch: Flip The Script
notes.content:
Welcome back, Scribes! It's time for a flippin' new spell!

This update includes Unfold: a new Movement Spell, New Maps, A Tutorial Kit adjustment, and some light fixes!

We also shout out the new Community Mod Library - hardworking Scribes making their mark on the game! Check out the highlights below and keep an eye on the Roadmap in Vellum's main menu as we go. 


New Movement Spell - Unfold
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/a5a37375b641d7abe825a5f3e2a90ad54426af74.gif"]

Mental gymnastics? Watch this!

Keep an eye on your foes as you soar backwards through the air with Unfold!

This acrobatic Movement Spell flings you out of danger, granting a brief moment of invulnerability, and offers many pages to build more style into your aerial feats!

Drop deadly mines, craft a winning floor routine, and perform some high-damage trick shots to style on your foes! 


New Maps
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/3029d285277d6cfb4fb2552f5902ee2459457104.jpg"]

Roots and shoots and roads...

Venture to fresh combat arenas: Sequoia and Outlook! Fight beneath the tall trees, making use of long-range cover for a forest fight to be remembered.

In Outlook, weave between pillars of an ancient structure - where do these old roads lead? Battle the Torn in a time-worn relic of elsewhere!

 
Spend Early, Spend Often - Tutorial Spell Changes
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/19614c658a259af5c79f18998e931b200bc80ba4.jpg"]

Note: This will unlock Callback for all Scribes, while re-locking Swoop!

We're making some initial changes to the new player experience with adjustments to the Tutorial Chapter! 

The order of some elements has changed to give Scribes more time to understand the Signature Ink choice they make. Additionally, we're making Callback the new default Spender Spell! 

This gives new Scribes a more versatile starting spell set to take into their first Of Scribes and Torn run - Callback's area damage capabilities are a smoother compliment to Jot! 

 
Community - Mods and More!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/ca043850a17e45e86434c10453b0c58a160ffbee.jpg"]Just a bit of tINKering...

There has been some awesome community work on Mods for Vellum! Pet the Inkling, pack more decoration into your Reading Nook, and more creative additions await! 

You can find these mods in the Discord Community Mods Library - a special thanks to the authors for your excitement and sharing your work!

 
Epilogue
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/9b6c070b5d585ffb1e675a5be2accc603edff872.jpg"]

The quiet calm of a book club!

Keep an eye out for Vellum in the Yogscast Small Teams fest currently on Steam! In other news, we're gearing up for the next Major Chapter - more info to come, with plenty to read.

Thank you to our testers, everyone in the discord, our newest mod-makers, and Scribes of all Ink Levels! 

- The Vellum Team

notes.title: Interlude Patch: "Spoilers"
notes.content:
Welcome back, Scribes! With 1.1: Beyond now behind us, we look to new waters - beginning with a fresh new spell! 



-- Interlude Patch: "Spoilers" ahead... --



This update includes Spoil: a new Spender Spell, Visual Intensity Settings, Raid-Specific Spell Tuning, and several bug fixes, minor adjustments! Keep an eye out for some snazzy new Nook Items, too!

Check out the highlights below and, as always, you can track our journey from the Roadmap in Vellum's main menu. We also discuss our continuing Vellum plans at the end of this post! 


New Spender Spell - Spoil
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/16ffa559c7abe9523acca579c82564a250d5801f.gif"]

How 'bout them apples?

Brand new to the spellbook, Scribes get to live a fresh, ripe, totally-not-rotten fairytale fantasy with Spoil! 

"Offer" your foes a scrumptious bite of a Spoiled Apple and watch as they share their positive reviews with nearby pals! These Apples are tasty, healthy, and only get better with a hefty helping of Pages of Power!

Aim true while flinging bushel after bushel of this sticky, explosive 1-Cost Spender... and find out just how hungry the Torn really are.


Visual Intensity Settings
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/8050a093ceadb6206fd5c597019823b10435b378.jpg"]

Details and details and details!

We're introducing Visual Intensity Settings based on your feedback! These new options allow you to further customize your experience for increased performance and legibility both solo and in multiplayer. 

In pursuit of these changes, our VFX system has had performance improvements across the board (even without using these new settings!). 

Player spells and effects now have a Reduced and Minimal VFX setting.

Enemy abilities and effects now have a Reduced and Minimal VFX setting.

There are a lot of visuals in Vellum - please let us know how your experience with these new settings goes!


Raid-Specific Spell Tuning and Balance
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/a2b6a6dfee75b65e0fbd68d4c62b08e004ee6285.jpg"]

The flexible spellcraft of Scribes is a complex curriculum. Time to teach the Torn Lords a lesson or two.

With the rise of the Torn Lords, we've found (with the help of plenty of feedback!) the disparity between spell damage across the different loadout options in Raids is larger than we'd like! 

The lower number of pages available in Raids combined with the Boss/Single-Target heavy encounter profiles, has resulted in some spells falling behind in power/excitement. With Interlude Patch: Spoilers, we're pumping up the damage output of several spells when damaging Raid Bosses only. 

Foil, Punctuate, Enkindle, Quip, Blossom, Wordsmith, and Passage will now deal 20 - 66% increased damage to Raid Bosses (details in the patch notes below). Let us know how these feel!


Epilogue
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/cea9b5b888446e2f286fae829d201515c518cc84.jpg"]

Finding a cozy nook in the Illuminated Library to keep reading!

With The Grey Area, The Forgery, and Yonder now complete along with the Early Access journey - we're going to be adjusting our cadence of content! We're incredibly proud of the speed, quality, and quantity of Vellum's Major Chapters and Interlude Patches thus far... especially when we're operating as such a small team (if you're active in the Discord - you've likely heard from all of us directly by this point!)

Since EA launch, we typically added new content about every two weeks, alternating between Interludes and Major Chapters. Of course, some updates had adjusted timings for major life events and bigger-scope items (especially as the Library Update, Raids, and 1.0 approached). 

As a small team, we'll remain incredibly flexible (today's patch includes feedback from this morning - we love this!), but we'll be targeting a few more weeks between updates and more Interludes between Major Chapters. This new pace lets us stay reactive to feedback, continue to chase cool ideas, and gives us more time to plan what comes next!



Thank you for playing Vellum and joining us as the literary journey continues to unfold! Go read a book!

- The Vellum Team

notes.title: Interlude Patch: In Circulation
notes.content:
Welcome back, Scribes! It's been almost two weeks since 1.0 dropped and we've been blown away by the enthusiasm and support for Vellum. Thank you!

Today - we're channeling our own 1.0 excitement into Interlude Patch: In Circulation!

This update includes Circulate: a new Movement Spell, Performance and QOL Upgrades, Book Club Reward Updates, Vignette Secrets, an Ascendant Rewards Adjustment, Raid Tuning, Photosensitivity Mode and many bug fixes.

Check out the highlights of this patch below and watch for our next update: 1.1 - Beyond! As always, you can track our journey from the Roadmap in Vellum's main menu (quite the saga!). 

New Movement Spell - Circulate
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/ca28858adf34289cec867609af7f6cc8fbb060c7.gif
Go for a leisurely scroll...

Build momentum with mounting anticipation and a trusty Scroll - then zoom off into and through your foes with the first Movement Spell to have baseline damage!

What wild combos will you skillfully scrawl into existence? Use the new Pages of Power and clever strategy to show the Torn what 'doom-scrolling' really looks like!

Vignette Secrets?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/8bf32d31898ec7b07274155cecb1f849ee63763f.jpg
Intrepid adventurers may have noticed some extra secrets and rewards in the various Vignettes found within the Tomes. Sometimes these hidden rewards give new Pages of Power, Temp Mana, or other useful statuses. 

I dare not speak further of such secrets - only to say that previously secret-lacking Vignettes are now up to date with something more to discover. Happy hunting!

Performance and Quality of Life
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/8050a093ceadb6206fd5c597019823b10435b378.jpg
Performance and quality of life have been top of mind for us since the 1.0 launch! With today's Interlude Patch, we're taking a more ink-laden pen to performance! Many of the wild interactions between mechanics in Vellum come down to core building blocks: Projectiles, Areas of Effect, Statuses, and Augments. Improvements in this patch aim to smooth out each of these pillars' performance - both in solo and multiplayer games!

We've also made a number of networking changes and upgrades aimed at improving the stability and synchronization of your team-up scribbling adventures!

Elsewhere, in the realm of Quality of Life - we're directly addressing feedback in a few key areas: we're adding new toggles for photosensitivity and visual effect intensity, we've clarified language and tutorials in the beginning of the game and throughout the Binding/Attunement/Ascendant processes, and smoothing out other experience-impacting bugs!

Please continue to share your feedback with us as you interact with these systems!

Reward Upgrades - Book Club & Ascendant Progress
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/363701efba78a54b73b758b7f3d8e2c43f646850.jpg
The Book Club is now more rewarding! From now on, you'll be able to gain a first-time 500 Quillmark + Gilding bonus from playing new Book Club challenges - the perfect way to spice up your journey as a Scribe. Because Book Club challenges are ink-level-agnostic, tackling the Book Club right after Ascending may be a great way to kickstart your level-ups! On that topic...

Ascending is now more clear, no longer restricts Tome access, and will now allow multiple Bindings to drop at once when Over-binding Tomes! As a bonus - Ascendant Scribes also start with 500 Quillmarks to more flexibly reignite their journey!

Ascending in Vellum is designed to be an optional way to continue playing the game - we want it to be rewarding and fun, but not feel like a mandatory part of your journey. We'll continue to keep an eye on this system - let us know what you think!

Raid Tuning
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/0b0224fc2ac769a90ecd012f54de11a60084051b.jpg
We're adjusting and improving many aspects of the Torn Raids - from multiplayer scaling and boss ability frequency to visual telegraphs and Codex hints. Full details are in the patch notes below, but Araxiom, The Taking Tree, Styxen, and both Torn Lords have all received adjustments.

Quillmark and Gilding rewards have also been increased to help celebrate your victories!

Epilogue
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/ed9da06cc93332211e5af73045db22f8cc7fc052.jpg
Eyes on the Horizon...
1.1 - Beyond is coming soon and the Tangent Lord's curiosity knows no bounds!

In the meantime, come join us in the official Discord to share your feedback and show off your achievements, strategies, and your Reading Nooks designs (in a new dedicated channel)!

If you've been enjoying your time in Vellum, please consider leaving a review on Steam (it's a huge help, we read them all, and we always love to hear about your experiences)!

Thank you for playing Vellum - write on!

- The Vellum Team

notes.content:
It's time to grab your quills and inkwells, Scribes; Early Access is now complete!

Welcome to Vellum 1.0 - let's take a look!
[previewyoutube=dZbPQXX25O0;full][/previewyoutube] Together, you've helped us take Vellum on a journey through 23 major updates - crafting 13 new Spells, three new Signature Inks, hundreds of Pages of Power, new arenas and biomes, Torn Elites and Bosses , a dreamy new Illuminated Library, customizable Reading Nooks, and countless other improvements of all shapes and sizes!

Just to keep track - sneak a peek at all the progress we made since March 28, 2024! For the sake of an image that fit - we combined all the Interlude Patches into their nearest Major Chapter (the in-game roadmap remains uncollapsed, go check it out). 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/625f08e7ec388f80e841dfa4c82ec230860ca6a9.jpg

Raids - The Ultimate Test of Ink!
The saga of Scribes & Torn spills over into new ground as we come face to face with Vellum's most perilous challenges yet - Raids! The Grey Area and The Forgery are dangerous worlds containing brutal new bosses, devious  encounters, and dramatic confrontations directly with the Torn Lords!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/f9b7c8f2e87bc692e11bfa32165c8e11c93cdaad.jpg
Scribes will be able to take on the intense and climactic challenges of two Raids - each with Normal and Hard modes - setting the perfect stage for uncovering and thwarting the Torn Lords' meticulous plots. 

You'll face mechanically complex encounters all fully available solo or with your closest pen-pals. Normal difficulties unlock at Attunement 7 & 14 - tailored for a good early to mid-game challenge, while Hard Modes are built for an end-game experience (unlocking after completing Normal).

By the numbers - Scribes braving these newest threats to the Library will see 4 Major Encounters and 2 Vignettes in each Raid with typical runs targeting 30 - 45 minutes. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/3d45456203d463169578524bd463a5ee756a8f2a.jpg

The Grey Area - Home of the Ravings
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/af7999ca2f4b59706bb5d72d79ba35bd291f69f1.jpg
The Grey Area is the realm of the Ravings, a forested and decaying keep where Scribes will brave the Raving Lord's twisted view of beauty. If they can defeat an arachnid general, navigate a haunted forest, and nip a terrible plant in the bud - Scribes will reach the Raving Lord's citadel and the malevolent ambition within.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/183a0b381be91304033fbc9b9e0cf8f96d8c072d.jpg

The Forgery - Land of the Splices
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/43df82083a753246541bde83061cf8896d9543c1.jpg
The Forgery is the realm of the Splices, a sandy lava-filled foundry, where Scribes will see the dazzlingly awful machinations of improperly used pages and ink. Here they will confront the Splice Lord after carving their way through his dreadful armory, fearsome constructs, and ever-unfinished fortress.

For the first time, Scribes will battle outside the books and without the help of the Library. How will their Ink fare in the dreaded Torn Realms?

Raid Rewards
This 1.0 update also brings many raid-related rewards including customization for your personal Reading Nooks and new Pages of Power to use in your Tome runs. We're also introducing a new way to customize your Scribe's wardrobe - Curiosities!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/87210b2d50ea898aba8eeff4c9d16c825cd6613f.jpg
As Scribes encounter the terrors of the Torn Realms, the Codex will update to provide helpful Encounter Info about each challenge within the Raids. Every completion of a Raid will also Stamp Each Page, Spell, and Signature Ink used in your winning builds!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/2678cb04f4c8c1283d821a0631f60f4df9b4d3d7.jpg

Quality of Life, Balance, and Everything
It just wouldn't be a Major Chapter without a whole list of other improvements, would it - and how better to wrap up Early Access than taking a crack at a few community-requested items? Let's review some!

In the eternal campaign to get everyone to read more... Status Effects are now hoverable and include as much supplemental information as possible! Though some select effects may retain their - uh - mysterious natures (we totally know what they do).

We've tackled more areas in pursuit of clarity - in fact - you can now see more areas with today's inclusion of Camera Distance and Camera FOV settings! The Torn never looked so menacingly scary... or so tiny, cute, and far away? On that topic...

Since early on, we've seen feedback on enemy visual clarity. Not only in moment to moment gameplay, but also when picking Torn Pages! Our strategy in 1.0 allows the dreaded Torn to soak up a hint of identifiable color from the Tomes they're invading - but only based on their type! You'll see a bit of Green in Raving foes and abilities, Red in Splices, and Blue in Tangents. This also applies to their names, allowing you to more confidently target the greenish bear over yonder after picking "Ravings will now sit and taunt you after missing 3 spells."

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/85f01042344eaa8624959cd037e7956efd7498da.jpg

The Story Continues
The realms of the Torn hold many dangers and many answers - from the depths of the Raving Lords's Haunted Metaphorest to the Splice Lord's Maxim Excavation, the story of Vellum continues to unfold.

Scribes who best these Raids will prove themselves ready to defend the Illuminated Library from the Torn's next challenge - the confounding secrets of Yonder, home of the Tangent Lord. This third Raid will be available after launch.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/1ff06c0c1b2b6dd44d99cb95365ebfe102597ba1.jpg
Acknowledgments
Whether you've lived with Vellum over the last year or are just about to crack open the magic Tomes for the first time - we offer you our sincerest thanks and simply cannot wait for you to play. 

We're always eager to hear about your experiences in Vellum - they continue to help us make the game better. If you play and enjoy the game, please consider joining our Discord and/or leaving a review on Steam (even if it's only to tell us the name of your favorite book of all time)!

Thank you for joining our book club - enjoy Vellum! 

- The Vellum Team

notes.title: Interlude Patch: In The Edit
notes.content:
Welcome, Scribes!

We hope you've been enjoying all the cozy additions to the new Illuminated Library! Today, we're publishing Interlude Patch: In The Edit! With the sheer amount of new goodies in our previous Major Chapter - today's patch was the perfect opportunity to take a hard look at every nook and cranny of Vellum, dip into the magic ink, and come up with a myriad of improvements.

This update takes a massive step in the Performance, Balance, Reworks, Polish, and so many aspects of Vellum!

Performance, Art
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/97f8c99844526e1057e108161b5d07de42c5a5c6.jpg
We're addressing one of the Torn's greatest weapons against the Scribes - Framerate.

We've made absolutely massive strides in the performance of the game. Playing through a Tome, picking upgrades, waiting for the enemy to begin a battle, casting spells - there are thousands upon thousands of connections between the host of systems in Vellum.

Reducing the performance cost in any single item could have huge gains. 

We've reduced the cost of: Projectiles, Area Effects, Scribe Passive Stats, Torn Passive Stats, Status Effects, Pages of Power, Signature Ink core mechanics, User Interface items, Screen Effects, Fog, Lighting, every action Scribes and Torn take - oh and the small item of networking all these things.

Multiplayer Games, High Appendix Runs, Steam Decks, PCs of varying power - no matter how you enjoy the magic ink, Vellum just became that much smoother to play!

Balancing Spells and Ink
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/7af1cccf7016113be533f5e4ddb360e25da13d9c.jpg
Spells and Ink... dripping with potential!

We're buffing many spells in many ways based on feedback and the continually awesome community discussions! This also comes with some strategic redistribution of power of some spells (Eclipse) and a handful of minor (but needed) nerfs (Ghostwrite, Vault). You can read the huge amount of changes in the patch notes a the end of this blog post.

Affected Spells - Punctuate, Quip, Draw, Swoop, Passage, Blossom, Eclipse, Foreshadow, Flutterstep, Ghostwrite, Vault

Our goal with these changes is to make these spells all more competitive, while opening up their viability when combined with different signature inks (e.g. Draw)! 

On the Signature Ink front, MANY inscriptions have been rebalanced and Green Ink has been the recipient of several quality of life changes (like a hud indicator) and significant buffs.

Remastering Tomes and Pacing
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/463096fae2a2a31aa889c31bc64220f542cb9899.jpg
The Scribes explore magical strengths, collecting powerful Pages - and the Torn rise to meet them...

Tomes are the battleground of our colorful conflict with the Torn! Bigger and more compelling threats invite stronger choices and more dynamic strategies.

We've refactored the way encounters happen throughout the Tomes - strangely, it's a lot of work that hopefully fades into the background! You'll see a larger variety of foes as you play and the danger ramps up - setting you and the Torn up for more dramatic, compelling, and fluctuating battles!

For new players - we're also opening up the choice to jump into Appendices from the very start! 

The Clarity of Bindings and Bosses
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/ac56f3d552e8666d04878065eee437411df429b0.jpg
Deeper evils fester and brood!

Bindings have been rebalanced - we're upping the point values to give you more customization AND clarity in the ever-evolving battle with the Torn. Many Bindings now contribute much more to the Attunement goal while playing - though be warned, the Torn still grow stronger!

At the end of these newly re-organized Tomes, held together with reevaluated Bindings - who better to test your rebalanced Spells and Ink against than the Torn Bosses?

We'll be focusing (and talking) more on Bosses in the future - but In The Edit brings some fresh polish to our grand foes! There are visual and audio feedback enhancements across the board, with some behavior and cooldown adjustments thrown in - all in service of boss fights that put your Scribe skills to the ultimate test (while being clear, fair, balanced, and satisfying). 

The Polish of Pages - and All Other Things!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/1855658b811bfe1fe9874ff28bedfaa6244b0bb1.jpg
Details on details on details...

This interlude patch includes so much additional detail - Chapter endings, UI sound effects, fanfare, feedback, and so on! One of the most noticeable changes will be Pages of Power, now much more clearly identifiable in their grandeur!

Magical Pages will now be appropriately decorated as Storied, Renowned, Epic, Legendary, or Unique (if you're lucky enough to read one)!

If any details stand out as your favorite or you have feedback to share with us, please do! So much of this update was driven by feedback; it is truly helpful to us.

Epilogue - One Big Library
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/49f6ec2addd14be460062522516bce050963140e.jpg
Interlude Patch: In The Edit also brings a handful of new Nook items - and introduces the community-requested ability to place items under tables (push in your chair, create your own dioramas, get creative)!

This update went through a fluid process with a lot of builds going on the testing branch. Hunting bugs, giving suggestions, breaking things in brand new ways - thank you everyone who tested In The Edit ahead of time! 

As we look to the horizon, Vellum's full launch is drawing closer - and you can definitely expect it to be a rather large update! In preparation for 1.0, we'll be targeting smaller, Interlude Patch-sized updates (a truly hilarious thing to say in this particular blog post - yes) that will allow us to stay responsive to feedback, squeeze in some cool extra stuff, and keep focused on the next verse of this saga!

Thank you for playing Vellum - go read a book!

- The Vellum Team

notes.title: Chapter X: Illuminated - Now Live!
notes.content:
Welcome Home, Scribes!

The Illuminated Library takes center stage in our 20th update of Early Access - Chapter X: Illuminated! 

This is the largest single piece of content yet - containing our Elevated Library Design, Reading Nooks, Tome Items, Activities, Secrets, Lore, and more - take a look!

[previewyoutube=Z9n7UwlFhI8;full][/previewyoutube]
This magical evolution of our favorite impossible-yet-possible reading space has been in the works for several months! Check out our overall progress with our trusty Table of Content below:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/6d7d41a5c0ce8d8120dff5da2c9b5655768502f4.jpg

Illuminated Library - Elevating the Home of Scribes!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/ab86365136ce418273bd7ba5f2e6ec851a99881e.jpg
Early Access has seen a huge number of improvements to the gameplay pillars of Vellum - from new Spells and Ink for Scribe to dangerous new Torn threats and new Tomes to mend!

Our tenth major chapter gave us the opportunity to look homeward to the Illuminated Library, ask tons of questions, and elevate the design of more physical pillars of the game!

What makes this place feel more real? What makes this place feel more magical?

What makes this place feel like home?

Reading Nooks - Styling Your Own Space!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/f320e3315cec3e00837a6244e277f6973df7c9f3.jpg
Reading can be a very personal experience - so where better to enjoy a quick chapter than your own Customizable Reading Nook?

With over 220 decorations and furnishings, you'll be well-equipped to develop, design, and display your personal style.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/029b0b56b5c9c2bf78562da1b7d761a8df616bdd.gif
Reading Nooks and a selection of decor are available to all Scribes from the start (everything in the image below is unlocked by default!). Gildings (gained in the normal course of mending Tomes) are the primary unlock method - though some items may require specific achievements to acquire. 

After completing a particularly economic Tome - new items will also drop when mending Tomes!

Will you craft a cozy, comfy, fire-lit nook? A whacky shrine? A gallery? It's up to you!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/8030e474c1741a9011201307c259f0677732ec35.png

Tome Novelties - Pet The Wolves, Race Your Friends!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/9cea746bd79b3ccbe110ce54d48571acebfe7a83.jpg
As mysteries unfold and Scribes continue the battle against their new colorless foes, something strange has begun... 

Novelties from the Tomes have followed us back to the Illuminated Library! These entries appear while progressing through Vellum. In our overview video above, we show two of these strange happenings.

First - and perhaps the most important - Dawn and Dusk appear AND YOU CAN PET THEM!
Second - after a fabled Tome concerning contests of speed - Race Courses become available in the Library! 

Host a friendly test of speed with your fellow Scribes, with unique courses based on your Movement Spell!

Each Tome will affect the Library after the first mending - there's so much to discover!

Inscriptions, Speed, and More In Store!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/64468ce0e0f6efe8e360e956dfe26f2fb896eee6.png
The Font of Ink facilitates travel through Tomes - but also throughout the Library! The Inkways speed Scribes on their way from shelf to shelf!

Coalesced ink can be found and collected in the form of Quillmarks - but also give some extra speed in these great halls with the help of Library Inscriptions.

Learning from our fabled tortoise - slowing down to examine the details of the Illuminated Library may be a quick path to some additional insights into the literary world of Vellum.

Gameplay Tweaks - Page Adjustments, Area Effects, More!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/dd3603f37d992edf56d3b09147559db4d8144a01.jpg
And inside these countless Tomes? For the Scribe on the mending road - we've made a series of gameplay adjustments in Chapter X (with a much more performance/content/balance-focused interlude patch to come in February) .

On the Page of Power front - we've added pages to help give all Signature Inks access to stronger late-game scaling (particularly in builds with a heavy Generator/Spender damage focus). 

Many Area of Effect attacks/hazards have been converted to cylinders - allowing more accurate safety when jumping over an acid pool or similar effect.

Joust (Punctuate) and Grapple (Quip) have also been updated ahead of their (potential spoilers!) upcoming Book Club challenges!

Epilogue - At Home in the Library
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/7e35243ac4271050ced2466084daf10a04671394.jpg

This update spanned several months while we continued our Early Access process. Chapter X: Illuminated came from a truly monumental amount of intense work and planning that was filled to the brim with twists and turns. 

We've lived in these once-imaginary halls for a while now, working on features and details of all shapes and sizes - we couldn't be more proud to share this new chapter of Vellum with you.

Welcome back to the Illuminated Library - happy reading!

- The Vellum Team

notes.title: Interlude Patch: Author-ity
notes.content:
Hail, Scribes - and happy New Year!

Welcome to the first update of the year, Interlude Patch: Author-ity! Wield an expensive new Spender Spell, express yourself with Emotes, test your damage with Endgame Review, relax in new Vignettes, and enjoy many smaller improvements!

Our next major chapter comes later this month- be sure to keep up with our progress with the in-game roadmap!

Overrule - Dealing With Difficult Subjects
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/df7ee3d857826b54598424a9be19f2823e23749a.jpg
O hail the Sovereign Scribe - first of their fame, guardian of the Library, descendant of the first mend, collector of pages and chromatic wielder: INKBORN! 

Overrule is the newest Spender in the Scribes' arsenal; Ascend and brandish a Sceptre for 2.5s to sentence foes to destruction!

The Torn are indeed difficult subjects - but this high-damage, single-target beam of power might just be the answer! As an expensive spell, make sure to keep 3 mana in your coffers to deal with the challenges throne your way.

Emotes - It's An Expression
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/493c15b79a04e0f69ef6769ded5ebfe5c609162a.gif
Sometimes, in multiplayer games, jumping and pinging and random spells just isn't enough to really get your point across.

Sometimes, you just need the perfect gesture to Emote with! We've added a selection of emotes purchasable in the Illuminated Library with Gildings.

Equip your 4 favorite, most contextually-expressive actions and become the thespian you were meant to be!

Vignettes - Duality of Respite
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/34b1ae89a071cce7982e6855a616dda1f76ec452.jpg

To find oneself in strange times and stranger lands can be a wish come true.

To lose one's self in such reveries, however...

Endgame Review - Practice & Theory
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/82f94a1701696544a0e75d8c3c735dfaef097da9.jpg
Tome? Mended. Boss? Defeated. But how?!

Enter the Endgame Review - after defeating a boss, Scribes can summon a set of training dummies to unleash and observe the power of their Pages and Ink.

Attacking these dummies records a rolling average of Damage Per Second on the back board - review your build or just practice, then head back to the Illuminated Library or brave the Appendices! (Speaking of reviews - if you're enjoying Vellum Early Access so far, let us know in the Steam Reviews; it helps us a ton!)

Epilogue
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/8273da6a44d29be4a10a0a85e02ee511a89e76dd.jpg
Interlude Patch: Author-ity has tons of goodies to kick off the year, lots of details and some quality of life improvements to accompany the content centerpieces. There's so much more to come as the 1 year mark of Early Access approaches on the horizon.

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Chapter IX: The Book Club - Now Live!
notes.content:
Good day, Scribes!

We close out the year with Chapter IX: The Book Club! Join your fellow Scribes in a rotating series of unique challenges, face the newest Torn foes, and enjoy a collection of gameplay, quality of life, and performance enhancements! 

In the New Year, our Early Access journey continues with our next Interlude Patch on January 8th. Check out our abridged Roadmap below, or the full version in-game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/567dd331503ebf5d4b4dbe18d8d755af677e98fc.jpg

The Book Club - A Game of Rotating Challenges
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/7647234eaa90c4c1163da64a9ce666c40794f43a.jpg

Where all Scribes start on the same page!

Tackle rotating challenges with a globally shared Loadout, Modifier Set, and Game Seed. Beware, Ink Levels and Inscriptions will not be applied!

The Book Club challenges will rotate every 3.5 days, introducing new thematic runs - each with a curated arrangement of our literary Spells, Tomes, Bindings, and starting Buffs! 

Since we Book Club members are facing the same limited-time obstacles, Scribes will be able to review global stat Reports on Completion Time (defeating Ch6 Boss), Highest Appendix, and a Challenge-Specific Stat during each challenge period.

How much pet damage did you deal in The Lord of the Inklings? How fared your sword-play in Duelist's Fate? Join the Book Club and put your reading skills to the test! 

The Shredded Torn
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/b028d3791b850e9e6f594fc298962bd4b2bebd5e.jpg

The looming threat of the Torn continues to grow with new minor foes for Splices, Ravings, and Tangents.

Face off with the skittish ram-like Gruff, the indulgent Ruminator, and the distantly harrying Apostrophe.

And - upon a mighty wind sails the dreaded Howl - a bold and zephyrous Elite Splice.

Going Overboard - Quality of Life, Manifest Rework, And More!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/daed3516868b72bc1b042499238423750ba0b725.jpg

Chapter IX is a great opportunity for us to highlight some more community-requested improvements to Vellum! More information follows in the patch notes, as always - but we wanted to highlight some hits!

Codex Search: Hunt for pages by name, keyword, or associated spell!

Manifest Update: Manifest can now be skillfully feathered to maintain some attack speed while avoiding "Going Overboard".

Swoop Adjustment: This spell can now be repeatedly cast by holding the button!

Inkling Behaviors: Transformed Inklings will now leap to their targets! Inklings in the Library will follow their Scribe's lead when dropping combat - it's polite to be mindful of others in the Library!

Color Your World - Steam Community Items
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/1c8aac9c10034371d67e20ead2453152de64fc13.jpg

"What's your favorite Ink color?" became a far easier question for these Scribes - it was obvious from their Steam Profiles!

We've added a whole suite of new Steam Community Items to show off your all-time (or perhaps spur-the-moment) colorful Vellum favorites!

Epilogue - On the Nature of Seasons
Around this time last year, we were in the early stages of Early Access launch prep. Over the 2023 Thanksgiving break, we had published our announcement trailer and were approaching the Steam Next Fest with a Vellum Demo that was very quickly taking on stronger, bolder shapes. Players would go hands-on with the game soon. Real soon.

We previewed Vellum for many of our friends and family - leaning on a wide range of truly generous folks who offered much of their time to hear about the book game. 

Somewhere in the middle, our common refrain of "Could you try some new Vellum stuff?" transformed into something new and exciting of theirs:"So I've been playing a bit on my own and I think that..." -- Not only had our growing circle been kind with their time - but increasingly open with their imaginations and curiosity! To see that same generosity then carried on by our players has been truly inspiring.

Today, with our final chapter of 2024 hitting the magic shelves, we're extremely proud of the Vellum journey so far and the endless discoveries we've made together along the way.

Happy Holidays and thank you for playing Vellum!

- The Vellum Team

notes.title: Interlude Patch: Feast
notes.content:
Welcome, Scribes!

We've loved all the feedback and discussion after Chapter VIII: Hard Cover and the addition of the Teal Signature Ink! We continue to gather feedback and have been working on making improvements, with the next step being today's Interlude Patch: Feast. 

On today's menu: some community requests in the form of Page Omission, dramatically improved enemy Hit Reactions, and major strides in Game Performance! We've also continued to expand content to add variety to your adventures with new Vignettes and Player Pages.

As always, you can check the in-game roadmap to see what's coming up. But for now, let's jump into the additions!

Performance Improvements
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/d65ba51fbd40a91484a9aafb22345e52ee11b323.jpg
Like the Scribes and Torn - Performance is an evolving battle. Little wins here and there get pushed back by crazier combos and new features. Interlude Patch: Feast makes huge strides in winning back framerate with two major areas. 

The first is a new way of handling game actions (projectiles, explosions, arrow rains, etc.) by re-using old copies so we don't need to create or destroy effects each time they're used. This should give a sizable performance boost, particularly later in Tomes within the Appendices when hundreds of effects are happening every second.

The second big improvement is in how we handle the Torn and their stats and behavior. With some aggressive data caching, multi-threaded logic, and more optimized code flow - we've seen huge performance gains when there are many enemies on the battlefield.

While there is still plenty of room for improvement, these two major performance overhauls have increased performance in general combat by a significant degree. And in late game runs, we've easily seen 100x improvements, going from 'seconds-per-frame' to 60fps in many cases! 

New Vignettes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/863bc3fb1d134391e5d2d94620b7327c9e4c879b.jpg
Deep within the Tomes, Scribes can find themselves in three new Vignettes! Scale the fungal depths of Mycellum Quarry, take in the view in Overlook, and dance with Radiance.

New Lore pages have appeared in the Vignettes of Pride and Profit, further detailing the paths of Myriad, Verse, and Horizon.

Hit Reactions
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/2f008d7b5eca9e6bd197b5aa8fa59e7f6e966030.jpg
Another element of feedback we've seen echoed a number of times is wanting more feedback when you deal damage to the Torn.

This update adds two new interactions - Damage Animations and Hit Flash. Now, Torn will physically react to the damage they take, giving better feedback and making damage feel more impactful. Additionally, Torn you damage will flash the color of your Signature Ink, for some visible, thematic interaction.

If you find the Hit Flash distracting, you can disable it in the General Settings menu!

Pages of Power
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/06a4f33165d8edd7a0f065ff070edf13c07c6636.jpg
This update expands the Codex with over 20 new Pages of Power to help you push back the Torn! This time, we're focusing on build expansion and collaboration, with new interactions between your spells, as well as a bunch of new multiplayer Ink Combinations (for example: your Orange Atlas might apply Blot if a Blue Scribe is standing nearby)!

Page Omission
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/f4eea5a07fbffe3c68a10223f3a8200e5939c51d.jpg
Sometimes, you might pick up a page that doesn't quite cooperate with your build - now you can do something about it! By popular request, we've added the ability to Remove Pages of Power you pick up during your run - just hold right click on the page in the Tab menu, and you can Omit it from your book!

There might be a couple of odd interactions that need ironing out (omitting pages that give you stacking stats doesn't remove what you've already built up, etc.) - but we'll resolve them as we go, and we definitely think it's better to have the feature with a few quirks than not at all!

Epilogue
Interlude Patch: Feast also brings a smattering of bug fixes, adjustments, and some light tuning! We called this update 'Feast' for a few  reasons: to allude to the sheer amount of stuff, the Thanksgiving holiday, but more importantly - the communal nature of this update!

In each post here, we make a point to write out how thankful we are for the enthusiasm and generosity of our players. Today's patch truly embodies the joy of our Early Access process; nearly every aspect of Feast has been directly influenced by feedback and discussions in the community.

For those who celebrate it, have a superb Thanksgiving!
For everybody, thank you for making Vellum better with us!
- The Vellum Team

notes.title: Interlude Patch: Initiative
notes.content:
Welcome to the table! Heroes, as evening approaches a new blog post appears... It says across the top:

"Happy Wednesday, Scribes! Vellum Early Access continues the adventure with Interlude Patch: Initiative!"

It continues on, summarizing the game's patch today: Clatter - a new generator spell, the Torn Bestiary, Enhanced Healthbars, and the start of Improved Ascension mechanics. 

With your passive perception score, you also notice the post eloquently reminds you that the Vellum Roadmap is available in game - always charting the development team's progress.

What do you do next? 

New Spell - Clatter
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/e907722b7da7723064f0ba95ad69f85b79625081.gif
You want to battle? Great! 

Roll to attack with Clatter: a new generator spell that conjures a 20-sided die, then blasts it at your foes!

Clatter applies additional effects determined by the result of your conjured d20. These payloads vary from an explosive area burst generating extra mana at higher numbers to a gut-wrenching single point of damage when rolling a 1.

If only there were Pages of Power to force the hand of fortune...

The Torn Codex
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/407d49a605f5ea8eeb5d0b5581a9ecf6c7dfd93e.jpg
Ah - you'd like to research your adversaries? Good choice - they carry many secrets!

The Codex has expanded again with lore and combat information about each of the Torn enemies you've encountered in your journey as a Scribe.

Whether you're waiting for your teammates to decide their loadouts or licking your wounds after a tragic defeat - there is always time to study your foes!

Enhanced Healthbar Information
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/d921d5734d5abb0cfdb7c40f8bc01d70b7bfc538.jpg
I understand - you'd like to learn in the heat of combat!

With the new Enhanced Healthbars, you'll be able to track the important buffs and debuffs currently affecting the enemy Torn.

This includes specific statuses from your Signature Inks, like Blue's Blot and Pink's Outline.

Improving Ascension Mechanics
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/f1e722394378018d31be00a77eaf4f1fec807f63.jpg
As a more experienced adventurer, you'd like to reset and try a new path? Right this way...

We're iterating on the experience of an Ascendant Scribe! There has been a helpful amount of feedback around the rewards and pacing goals of resetting progress and continuing the journey.

Now, after Ascending for the first time, Scribes will be reset to Attunement 5. In addition, Ascendant Scribes - hungry for challenge or eager for faster leveling - will now be able to accelerate their Attunement increases:

For every 5 Binding levels above the target Goal, a successful run will add +1 to your Attunement increase! 

We also know there is an appetite for more uses for Quillmarks and Gildings - we're on the case!

Epilogue
Heroes - time for a snack break!

It has been an exciting and eventful stretch for us recently; we remain committed to finding new ways to creatively meet the challenges ahead - both expected and surprising!

Thank you for your support, feedback, and enthusiasm.

Fun session, friends! Same time next week?

notes.title: Interlude Patch: Preposition
notes.content:
Happy Wednesday, Scribes! Vellum Early Access blinks forward today with Interlude Patch: Preposition!

Positions are key in the two new combat Arenas - and Scribes can now equip themselves with a potent teleport: Foreshadow! New Font Powers will now appear in Tomes and the game sees widespread performance improvements, bug-fixes, and some nice quality of life features!

As always, the Vellum Roadmap tracks our journey across the Early Access process - check it out in-game to see what comes next!

New Arenas - A Destination Shredding!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/42017bd46397f00f98663f2a3f1f3d0f4ba8bdb9.jpg
Today brings two new combat Arenas! Push back the Torn on a tropical island inlet, complete with boardwalks and palm trees! 

Don't let your ink dry too fast in the second Arena - a mysterious ritual site deep in the desert... High ground, choke points, and a doorway fit for last stands and holdouts!

How shall the Scribes traverse such spaces?

New Spell - Foreshadow
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/a8b6f39356b5a7569d882c4fe0cdcd39073112e7.gif

Foreshadow. With two charges and unlimited range, this Spell lets bold Scribes warp themselves to face their targets head-on.

Be it aggressive gap-closing or panicked escapes - Foreshadow opens the door for incredibly fast-paced bursts of action.

Performance Improvements
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/4c4ba3006786bb3e61c9648d16e04e8df40cbf40.jpg

There are a lot of ground effects in Vellum at the same time (and sometimes the same space) - which makes today's performance improvements all the more impactful.

Projectors see a massive upgrade, affecting a large number of our area of effect spells and abilities. This should allow for smoother play under those high-load encounters - like when you've chosen "Raving area size increased by 50%" and can't seem to kill off all those darn scorpions...

Status effects - another widespread pillar of the game - have also seen dramatic improvements. Vellum now handles big stack counts (like with Orange's Survey effect) much more efficiently!

Font Powers - Thank Our Lucky Stars
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/2422bd8bb2caa31337d2cb0e3b1a5350fd6fba3c.jpg
We're adding some fresh new options to the general pool of Font Powers! These powers come in all shapes and sizes - including new drops, some anti-Torn counterplay, a BELL?!, and more. 

With 16 new options in the pool, we're looking forward to hearing about your mid-run choices and discoveries!

Epilogue and Errata
Interlude Patch: Preposition comes fresh off the heels of a massive Chapter VI update. We're continually energized to be reading and digesting your feedback -  from feelings on the Mana rework to questions on story elements, it is always an exciting and driving force for us to hear your experiences with Vellum.

We're also thrilled and intrigued when seeing new bug reports! The detail and back-and-forth is consistently helpful for us - and often sets up exciting puzzles for us to solve. Like Scribes, we get to explore the deep dark intricacies of the unknown and come out victorious!

Thank you for playing and helping to make the game better each step of the way!

- The Vellum Team

notes.title: Chapter VI: Looming Threads - Now Live!
notes.content:
Gather 'round, Scribes!

Vellum's journey continues in Chapter VI: Looming Threads! Not only does today bring more content, charging forward into the bright future of the game - this chapter also starts the unfurling of a dark past. 

The new spell: Weave, a menacing Raving Boss, Lore Pages, and an evolving rework of Mana await! 

Speaking of future and past - check out our Early Access progress below! It's a wild ride to read through chapter by chapter and imagine the game way back at the start of this process. No matter when you joined the story - thank you for accompanying us!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/78e9e51dfffc490f21f8609ab0a31533f63daed9.jpg

Lore & Legend
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/d4c8b221388a3f4da7d46081c4752e8c108f82e7.jpg
Inspiration is sometimes as simple as a wish granted. A wish denied. - Prism 

The Legend section of the Codex is now available! Inside, you'll find record of any pages of lore you have encountered in your journey as a Scribe. 

Scattered journal pages - left behind by various authors - will now appear in Vignettes, filling in bits and pieces of a particular history within the world of Vellum. 

Special note: existing pages (i.e. Library pages) have also been rewritten, but should appear in the Codex if you have progressed far enough.

The story will continue to unfold in future chapters!

Spender Spell - Weave
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/25bcb8f20b6a631353f5997603b46acf4e9cb2ba.gif

Weave a new path forward with the finest threads in fiction! This fresh variable cost Spender allows you to take full advantage of your pool of Mana: each additional Mana spent will summon more Needles. 

Weave: Continually spin mana into threaded needles that seek foes through terrain when released! 

New Raving Boss - Beware the Serpent
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/ea522f281ef7bc4e8cccc029bcaa3c6f709dbc3c.jpg
Don't let the crown fool you - a royal audience with Missra is far from diplomatic...

Mana Rework - Color My World
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/cce99d6d7812507f5df07c6a43db6258be4ef4cc.gif

Mana plays a central role in both the core combat rhythm of Vellum and the identities of Signature Inks. It has been a topic of incredibly detailed feedback since the beginning of Early Access - so we've had a solid period of time (while working on other game pillars) to collect our thoughts and goals.

This is an evolving rework - there are further steps beyond today's iteration! The central idea:

At maximum Mana, Generators will start colorizing Neutral Mana. 

We believe this deepens the baseline decision-making around the Mana economy: providing both familiar and enhanced ways to infuse the identity and potency of Signature Ink into your combat style.

Additionally, Scribes can colorize Temporary Mana - allowing you to actively take better advantage of a great number of pages. We've also introduced new Mana-specific Inscriptions (Ink Level 8) to further customize around your combat preferences.

With the importance of Mana as a fundamental aspect of Vellum, we are deeply interested in your feedback on this change!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/c811519b55f85046386ed4171804ed678a7cd861.jpg

This is a huge update for us - iterating on central combat systems, unfolding lore and legend, crafting new bosses, introducing a wild new Spell, and diligently working on pivotal future chapters in the background. Chapter VI: Looming Threads turns a page toward the wells of inspiration ahead.

Thank you for reading. Thank you for playing!

- The Vellum Team

notes.content:
Good day, Scribes! Today, we fan the flames of Vellum Early Access with Interlude Patch: Light Reading! 

Our 11th update introduces Enkindle, a new short-range Generator Spell, an aggressive Raving Elite, and the highly-requested Game Records!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/857fda1d0555c1b91819b0a65e300d4a0c46675d.jpg
The Codex now holds record of your game stats! This has been highly requested since day 1 - so we couldn't be happier to give Scribes the chance to learn from the past!

Good day, Scribes! Welcome to our ninth update, Interlude Patch: Full House - introducing multiplayer Quickmatch, the burst-fire spell Draw, Interface Pings, and more! 

We've been openly talking about public games since the launch of Vellum Early Access, often with the underlying goal of maintaining the best foundation for positive, shared experiences. This is a heavily-requested feature that opens some exciting new doors for Vellum.

notes.title: Live Update - 0.45.1 - (Difficulty Overhaul)
notes.content:
Hello, Scribes!

We're releasing a patch today to adjust issues and address feedback relating to difficulty. There are also fixes and enhancements to the recent Chapter III: Revelry & Respite update!

Overcoming satisfying hurdles is at the heart of Vellum; Scribes direct the hunger of their foes, apply dangerous Bindings to Tomes, and venture into the depth of the Appendices - all in a quest to battle and defeat the Torn. 

In service of challenge that is consistently satisfying, we're making significant adjustments to Vellum's difficulty.

Today's patch adjusts how Vellum scales enemies across the board (Chapters, Bindings, Appendices). First off, we've fixed an important bug that had previously undercut the scaling factor of Bindings - so our intended difficulty curve had been 'leaking' a portion of its potency.

To combine with Bindings, we're substantially increasing the starting health values of Torn - with a small bump to their per-Chapter scaling. We're also adjusting the timing for Barrier regeneration for both Scribes and Torn to take slightly longer - giving more weight to Barrier-related powers and gameplay. We want a much more dangerous - but satisfying - iteration of the Torn:

Our goal is for difficulty to be a better partner for player power - keeping focus on the best dynamic relationships of the game.

This is an impactful step toward balancing the game, but it isn't the last step. We're eager to hear your feedback when playing with these changes and examining where Vellum's challenges find their brightest spots.

Thank you for playing!

- The Vellum Team

Each Vignette has its own thematic activity or choice to engage with - be it a platforming puzzle, scavenger hunt, or some other mysterious feature! They also may reward Pages of Power that are your choice to take or leave behind.

These reprieves from the battle against the Torn appear three times in the course of a standard Tome (and once before the boss in each Appendix). From the start, casting your movement spell at the correct moment (in line with the game's music) grants Sync: a movement speed buff! Using the power of The Font, Scribes will be able to gain Sync in new ways - and with monumental new effects!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/080bc309aedabfe111974f2d017b0212bc94e570.png
The Quest Board in the Illuminated Library has expanded! Chapter III introduces a collection of Daily and Weekly quests to complete during your journeys against the Torn!

Augment your Quillmark collection by completing Daily quests and speeding up your Ink Research! Weekly quests grant a solid influx of Gildings to help expand your winning wardrobe!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/fa953393c41bee59338c7f54f0711342f0dc50a4.png

Epilogue
Chapter III: Revelry & Respite is an exciting update for us as we both push forward with the thematic vision of the game and create another new platform for future content! 

We're eager to hear about your experiences with Vignettes, the current state of the game, and what you might want to see next!

Thank you for playing and reading with us!

- The Vellum Team

notes.title: Interlude Patch: Till Death
notes.content:
Interlude Patch: Till Death
Good day, Scribes - we hope you've been braving the seasons and studying up on your Inks since our last Chapter! We've heard a lot of excitement for Pink - thank you for your enthusiasm! Today, we're rolling out our newest Interlude Patch: Till Death!

This patch addresses community feedback on death, danger, performance, Bonus Objectives, and balance! We also introduce a tiny new Boss we found. Let's take a look at the patch! (And, as always, you can check out the roadmap in-game to track our progress - and see what's next!)

Revisiting Danger and Death
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/0e329f1014586d7ce5916242c7deee77283dca8d.png
We love high-stakes windows in games; skill, luck, instinct, preparation - you meet the challenge with everything you've got! Victory or defeat, you face your moment of truth head-on.

In Till Death, we're making targeted changes to improve these moments. Previously, these high-stakes windows came and went too quickly without us knowing we were in them. That makes it hard for players to excel in the spotlight - to come out with a clear and earned victory or satisfying and fair defeat. The goal: You must FEEL when the stakes are high and BELIEVE you can affect them.

Our major changes: One-Shot Protection, Last Stand Removal (Solo), Last Stand Rework (Multiplayer)

One-Shot Protection - High danger hits are more likely to leave you at low health, allowing for players to react and take more dramatic advantage of moment-to-moment strategy and long-term build-making. This affects all Scribes (any levels, solo and multiplayer) and will not prevent death from intentional "Annihilation-level" events.

Last Stand Removal (Solo) - We want the "fight for your life!" drama to happen in the naturally occurring dire moments carved out by One-Shot Protection and your defensives/builds. Ink Level revives still function and have new places in the Ink Level unlock order.

Last Stand Rework (Multiplayer) - Reviving other players functions similarly to the current behavior. Downed Scribes may now choose to activate their Ink Level revives or keep fighting to fill up their revive bar. This bar is still capped and requires a teammate to stand nearby to finish the process. All downed Scribes now use a ranged Ink Torrent spell to damage foes from any range and stay engaged with the game around them.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/54c7d3ebae6cd1edf9e1ad747122289f21139135.png

Splice Boss - "Big" Cap
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/3cabad2309d1e25f075fefa2022960666a543ae5.png
We've foraged for a new Boss to add to the Torn roster: "Big" Cap! This fun little guy is just a cute and cuddly Splice Boss. 

It's probably best to let him plant all the mushrooms he wants...

Pages of Power, Balance & Tuning, and Bonus Objectives
We keep expanding the Codex! Till Death (as always) brings new Pages of Power - including an avenue for some Generator-centric builds!

We've also spent some time tuning Blue, not only with some new pages and adjustments, but a buff to the Spread keyword! Blue's ability to tackle larger threats should be enhanced, while still keeping value on multi-dotting.

Bonus Objectives have all been tweaked! Based on some player feedback and a couple pieces of new tech, we've taken a light touch to nearly every Bonus Objective. Notably, we've also taken a performance pass to help clean up some wild and unwieldy combos (or strange occurrences with ally/foes tags getting confused). 

Thank you for playing Vellum and sharing your thoughts with us!
- The Vellum Team

Welcome, Scribes!

Chapter II is here with Vellum's first new Signature Ink! Study up on Pink, Challenges, a new Tome, Boss, and more - but first, let's check out the roadmap progress:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/5caf1721e97a7f849520e314de4b06b961dc134e.png
This Chapter not only introduces expansions in three different areas for the first time (Ink, Tome, Boss) - it also brings Signature Challenges and the Quest Board - laying the groundwork for exciting future features! 

As if that weren't enough - we're also excited to address some community feedback with Skimming and a pair of quality of life features: Page Damage Credit and Randomized Loadouts. 

Pink Ink - Power, Potential, and Payoff
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/44f8f5fd81d351da26d59da59aab9b0d987406cc.gif
Pink is the Ink of potential; strategic preparation leads to powerful results as you set up plans - then execute them at the perfect moment. Pink also breaks the rules with its Signature Spell - gaining 2 Charges and a 10s Cooldown! 

OUTLINE - Spells that apply Outline also store their damage dealt around foes. Lingering Outlines on slain foes become Drafts.

Tome - On the Nature of Seasons
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/4a2737972e1e497c9d8790693d9014da1e66f53a.jpg
Brave the winter cold, bask in the summer sun, and weather the Torn's relentless hunger in Vellum's first new Tome: On the Nature of Seasons! New Boss

We've also heard the request for more information on builds - and after the last update - a way to shuffle loadouts quickly! Here's a quick summary of these new adjustments:

Pages Damage Credit - The end of game screen will now show damage attribution to specific Pages (where possible)

Randomize Loadout - A strange box has appeared next to the Loadout Podium, allowing quick, randomized Loadouts!


Vellum continues its journey in Chapter II: A Study In Ink - and we couldn't be more thrilled for you to join us!

notes.title: Chapter I: The Endless Saga - Now Live!
notes.content:
The Endless Saga Overview
Today, we're releasing our first major update - Chapter I: The Endless Saga! Let's take a quick peek at our updated roadmap, then dive into what The Endless Saga has in store!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/2d3efb36efd3f21e81d32989fbe06b49c8b5e3d2.jpg
The content of this first Chapter was heavily influenced by community feedback over the last month since launch, as well as discussion in the few weeks since we dropped our first Interlude Patch: Duels & Demise. 

Looking at the roadmap above, you'll see we also moved an extra Spell to this update - so we're adding both a new Spender Spell and Movement Spell! 

In addition to the major features of Chapter I, we've made sure to hit some special extra content pieces - including a much-requested "Apply Previous Bindings" button and a rework of the Yellow Signature Spell. 

We're eager to see how you fare against the Torn in Chapter I: The Endless Saga - so let's get started!

Endless - Face the Appendices
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/c7a2a01f5efb2cc803c4943471a437404f68a9d1.jpg
It's time to test the true might of Ink! 

Once unlocked (after your first game with Bindings), you'll be able to Face the Appendices when defeating a boss at the end of a Tome!

You and your fellow Scribes will be presented a difficult choice: pick 1 of 3 Appendices - randomly rolled groupings of Bindings! Beat the next three Chapters (2 standard, 1 Boss), then pick from additional Appendices and keep the run alive - if you can!

Prestige - Become Ascendant
When all the Ink has been researched - the cycle of Scribes will continue! Reaching Ink Level 30 unlocks the ability to Ascend - granting a new cosmetic and emblem to show your status as Ascendant. 

You'll then get to start your Scribe journey anew! You'll keep Cosmetics, Gildings, and Codex progress. We've also added the Lifetime Quillmarks tracker in the Codex for all Scribes, regardless of Ascendant status. 

New Spell - Blossom
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/0cc49828976fa3ef4940a2837084171f0deb1d5a.gif
Blossom is our first melee Spender Spell - coming fresh off the heels of Foil and a lot of feedback of "now let us blast the area around us". 

Blossom spends 2 Mana to create a field of flowers, dealing a burst of damage to nearby foes in an area centered on the caster. 

New Spell - Ghostwrite
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/0f1fd71faab8edf1e91af00082063600d0c9056d.gif
Ghostwrite, our first new movement Spell, allows Scribes to become incorporeal for a brief moment - taking reduced damaged and knockback effects.

A Rework and Some Quality of Life Features
With this new Chapter, we're reworking how Yellow's Signature Spell behaves. It will now guarantee ALL your spells Flourish for the next 3s, as well as adding an extra 50% extra damage on top of the existing Flourish bonus. We think this will be an easier iteration to get good, predictable value from! 

We have a few Quality of Life features we're sneaking into this update as well: an "Apply Previous Bindings" button, The Codex Lifetime Quillmark Tracker, and a clearer sequence when auto-reviving! 

New Pages & Balance
The Endless Saga introduces new Pages of Power: a selection of new pages for the two new spells - as well a several pages related to movement spells and invoking signature inks.

Balance and Tuning wise, we've adjusted the way defensive damage reduction is calculated - and have also brought Varnish down a bit in overall effectiveness. Additionally, with the introduction of Endless, some effects that could previously scale indefinitely now have caps. 

We've adjusted Inscriptions to accommodate these changes overall, as well as adjusting two of Blue's first row options.

Our sincerest thanks to you all for your continued feedback; knowing what is important to you is important to us.

See you in the Library - and the Endless Appendices beyond!
- The Vellum Team

notes.title: Interlude Patch: Duels & Demise
notes.content:
Duels & Demise Overview
Today, we're releasing our first Interlude Patch: Duels & Demise! Check out our Roadmap for more! 

We're fresh off launch and are continually surprised and energized by the feedback and reception of Vellum. The palpable joy in the reviews, streams, comments, and more have been incredibly heartening.

Feedback continues to fuel our process - sharing details about how your experiences in the game met/didn't meet your expectations will always be useful to us. Thank you!

Duels & Demise includes three core items: Foil, Death Recap, Pages & Balance

Foil: Mightier Than The Pen? 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/0f99f24aa0857d1910d004edfc1e1fc8b977fc7b.gif
Foil is a Generator Spell with up to three hits; summon an inky blade to slice twice, then lunge forward to damage many foes at once. Each swing restores some Barrier when hitting foes (but will not overflow).

Quality of Death Feature: Death Recap
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/a66bbecdf8e219cd6cb42916c1f2c3e0ae5f42a0.png
As the ever-evolving mission for more clarity and feedback in Vellum continues - we landed on the Death Recap as a useful addition.

You'll now be able to see the name, ability used, and damage dealt from the Torn who defeated you.

New Pages & Balance
Overall, this Interlude Patch introduces 12 New Pages of Power: a selection of 5 Foil-specific and 7 Signature Ink-specific pages.

We won't spoil them here, but some of these new pages play into the balance changes we're making with this patch - specifically looking at defensive options and potency available for different Signature Inks. We're keeping an eye out for over-performers and adjusting/redistributing strength in specific areas.

We're still collecting data and feedback from the first few weeks of launch - so we're not making a huge number of balance changes in this patch, but a more surgical selection. The introduction of Foil as a brand new combat area will surely add some new pressure and unlock new combinatoric strengths, so we'll be spending keen attention on balance and feedback.

Full Interlude Patch Notes: Duels & Demise
0.31.0
New Content & Balance
- New Spell: Foil - A melee Generator Spell, summoning a sword to deal a three-hit combo
- New Quality of Life Feature: Death Recap - Will show the specific Torn who dealt a killing blow (along with ability and damage value)
- 5 New Pages of Power - Foil
- 7 New Pages of Power - 1+ per Signature Ink
- Page of Power: Wards Wards Wards can now only activate once per ability, now generating 20 Barrier (was 30). (Dev Note: We pulled power from this overperformer and have added another Page to the pool that still incentivizes Yellow's 'defense via offense' feel)
- Page of Power: Phoenix now hatches new Swoops much faster
- Page of Power: Spread the Word now also heals
- Page of Power: New Author now takes 45s to deal 1,000,000 damage (was 60s for 10,000)
- Blot damage now starts at a higher base value, but scales more predictably and linearly on the same target as stacks increase (Dev Note: This is a slight buff to the lower stack counts, and a nerf to higher stack counts)
- Signature Spells can no longer have cooldowns reduced lower than 4s
- Binding: Toxic now reduces Torn damage by 75% (was 90%). (Dev Note: Toxic should be an intriguing trade off of danger profiles, but shouldn't be as strong a boon as it is currently)
- Torn Page: Warped now has an internal cooldown
- Torn Page: Blood in the Air now has a lower difficulty rating
- Torn Page: 5 Second Rule now heals Bosses for 10% (was 15%), lasts 15s (was 20), and has an adjusted hitbox
- Tome: Quarry should no longer buff multiple Torn - there can only be one!
- Tangent Boss: Tserak will now be stunned when Scribes destroy all crystals

General & Fixes
- Controller and Keyboard & Mouse switching improvements and fixes
- PlayStation Controller glyphs will now appear
- FPS is now uncapped when vsync is off 
- Added Texture Quality setting
- Improved Resolution Setting options (1440p)
- Binding Selection UI now has some improved elements
- Binding Book (at the Obelisk) has additional info on Attunement
- Attunement is now actually capped at 20
- Yellow's passive has a new visual indicating progress toward the next Flourish
- Inklings' basic spell is now more visually striking
- Inklings should no longer multiply without permission
- Signature Spell: Blue projectiles can no longer be intercepted
- Scribes should now auto-revive if they are dead during inappropriate times
- Scribes should maintain the correct number of Rewrites when reconnecting
- The Ink Research button has some improved interactions
- Knockback effects will no longer interact poorly with slows on Scribes
- Raving: Lizard should know how to land after leaping (perhaps it was falling and missing the ground)
- Adjusted the visibility of some Torn effects (Rat, Zombie, Minor Tangent projectiles)

notes.title: Vellum's Upcoming Chapters
notes.content:
Vellum, Early Access, and the Road Ahead 
Welcome, Honored Scribes!

As custodians of the Illuminated Library and protectors of its Tomes - you've already been hard at work pushing back the Torn! You've grown, your foes have grown.
Time for Vellum to grow!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/99159b6740da0be8ff70029b644e0f78dfe65b7b.jpg
This shows the structure of our planned updates - and we'd like to go into more detail on our first Interlude Patch and our first Major Chapter! The timeline of these will become more solidified as we refine our update cadence.

This is very fluid, will definitely change, and will be driven by your feedback as we continue through Early Access.

Interlude Patches & Major Chapters
Our plan for Vellum's Early Access development is split into two, alternating content types: Interlude Patches & Major Chapters. 

Below, you can see the kinds of items you can expect from these updates. These items won't all appear in every update; we want to create a compelling (and feasible) selection each time. Our goal is to release a variety within these updates where you can always come back to the Library to check out something new.
Interlude Patches include content like:

 Pages of Power
 Torn Pages
 Bindings
 Cosmetics
 General Font Powers
 General Bonus Objectives
 Quality of Life Features
 Balance & Tuning
Major Chapters include content like:

 New Major Features
 Spells
 Tomes
 Torn: Bosses
 Torn: Elites & Standard
 Map Sets
 Binding Sets
Let's explore what this looks like in practice! Here's a preview of our first Interlude Patch and Major Chapter!

For the First Interlude Patch...
Release Date: April 10th
New Spell - Foil
We're immediately, and stylistically, bending some rules to bring you a new Generator Spell in our first Interlude Patch. Normally, as you can see above, we'd wait for a Major Chapter to drop a new ability - but we want to cover an attack profile we've been eager to expand on: melee.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/c25a04d3bd430d0f798c3b3e4dffcd2b0b84b215.jpg
Foil is a three-hit combo generator ability - summoning an inky blade to slice twice, then lunge forward to damage many foes at once. 

We're pumped to bring our first melee spell to the game, and are looking forward to hearing and iterating on your feedback!

New Pages of Power
To continue on the feedback thread - we're planning to add a selection of new Pages of Power to be found in Tomes. We want to expand the coverage of defensive pages for some Signature Inks. We'll also be redistributing the power of a few over-performing pages to spread strength and make different angles more accessible (rather than too many feast or famine feelings). 

There's bound to be some fun shenanigans, as well!

New Quality of Life Feature - Death Recap
Dying is bad - but a death recap helps make resurrection that much better! Seeing who dealt you a killing blow should help with directing your vengeance - or simply learning a bit more about the dangers of those 37 extra Bindings you threw on because "how bad could they be, really?".

Major Chapter I: Endless Saga
Release Target: Late April
In the week since launch, we've heard a lovely piece of feedback: more. We're planning to address that feedback with two new features.

New Major Feature: Endless Runs
An endless mode has been suggested and asked about quite often - so we're making it the centerpiece of our first Major Chapter. Have the perfect build? Want to throw out just a few hundred more Swoops with that busted combo? Time to shine!

Once unlocked, you'll be able to Continue the Saga when defeating a boss at the end of a Tome!

You and your fellow Scribes will be presented a difficult choice: pick 1 of 3 Appendices - randomly rolled groupings of Bindings! Beat the next three Chapters (2 standard, 1 Boss), then pick from additional Appendices and keep the run alive - if you can!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/4508c7fd79a6149d20594293d7557877801c6bd0.jpg
New Feature: Prestige!
When all the Ink has been researched - the cycle of Scribes will still get to continue! We'll be adding the ability to Prestige, resetting your Ink Level, Binding Attunement, Quillmarks, and unlocks - but you will keep your Gildings and Cosmetics!

Reaching higher levels of Prestige will yield cosmetic rewards - show off all that research you've done! You'll also get the chance to admire your Lifetime Quillmarks - so don't worry about that stockpile you might be accruing!

New Spell: ???
We're raring to get more of our spell ideas out into the wild - each with their own upgrades and specific combat profiles. With a new Generator (Foil) coming soon, we're going to be looking toward the other spell categories to start rounding out more of the roster. 

This is a great area for your feedback to help us decide what's next in line - what are you interested in? What combat profile do you really want to spend all your mana on? How do you want to use a new movement spell to strategically enter/avoid combat? Let us know!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/9630518e04e7d70c4ee552ff15487011aaa45fb2.jpg
Epilogue
For us, Early Access is all about making new, exciting discoveries. The feedback process is pivotal in helping us make those discoveries together - it has already helped us immensely in shaping the outline for the future of Vellum.

There's no better time to join the Vellum Discord and tell us of your grand victories and heartbreaking defeats - we love to hear about them!

Thank you all and we'll see you in the Library!

- The Vellum Team

notes.title: Live Update - 0.30.3
notes.content:
Happy Wednesday, Scribes!

We've got another delivery of fixes and adjustments headed your way! This patch also includes some light balance changes and tuning. Let us know how impactful these changes feel as you go about mending the Tomes!

We're continuing our quests for improved performance, bugfixing, and controller tweaks. Please keep the reports coming our way - the clips, screenshots, and in-depth descriptions from the community have been a huge help in slaying these bugs.

What a wonderful launch week - thank you all for playing! This week, look for a blog post from us with details on the next chapters of Vellum. See you in the Library!

Balance & Tuning
- Scribe Barriers now recharge 33% of their full value per second, up from 15%. (Dev Note: This should help with getting back into the fray after being on the back foot, as well as increase overall survivability)
- Barrier regeneration is no longer delayed by damage that is fully absorbed/reduced
- Binding Levels above 46 should now scale damage and health properly. (Dev Note: This will increase difficulty, while aiming to keep high Binding Levels meaningful.)
- Font Power: Ballista now fires one large, piercing bolt instead of a burst of arrows
- Font Power: Chrome, Sweet Chrome now applies on tick, rather than needing to re-enter
- Boss Fights: adds spawn slower in co-op games, slightly reduced number of adds. This should result in more face time with just the Boss
- Torn Page: Morale Boost will no longer heal other Elites or Bosses. Phew.
- Binding Attunement Levels should now properly reach the Maximum Attunement Level (20). This caps the Quillmark bonus, but doesn't prevent playing at higher Bindings.  (Dev Note: Binding Attunement 20 as a maximum is our goal area for balancing difficulty and rewards - we want to make sure the appeal of Binding Levels above 20 is about the challenge, not necessarily optimal rewards)

Gameplay Fixes
- Bonus Objective: Collect is improved and should be less likely to spawn in impossible areas (please let us know if you find any more areas)
- Bonus Objective: Header is now more ball-like and has an indicator for the Font (Gooooooooooal!)
- Inscription: Refundable should now properly grant mana from Spender Spells
- Inscriptions: Green should now apply their proper bonuses when equipped
- Adjusted the Font Power rows for Tome: Rivals
- Adjusted visual size of Mortar-type explosions to better match their ground telegraphing
- Bonus Objective: Capture the Flag - Inklings and the Wolves will no longer pick up the Flag (put that down!)
- Fixed Zombies and Ghosts from spawning each other!
- The Last Stand timer should now correctly adapt to free revives versus earned revives
- Tome: Of Scribes and Torn can now be threatened by Splice and Raving bosses (was just Tangents)

General Fixes
- Fixed controller binding when trying to interact with LB/RB in Settings
- Reset settings button should correctly reset bindings to their default values
- Added "Hold" to the Tome Lectern in the Library for starting a game
- Misnamed Voting badges addressed
- Updated continue button in Font Powers
- Position of Scribes' Last Stand state has been raised slightly
- Fixed seeing a duplicate Lore Page later in the game instead of the proper page.
- Various Map Navigation issues resolved
- Tooltip adjustments and typo fixes
- Fixed a few instances of miscounting Players in a game
- Scribes should be less likely to arrive in random rooms
- Signature Ink Unlocks achievements should now be awarded at the appropriate time
- Achievement: Speed Reader should no longer be awarded during the Foreword
- Ink Level achievements should be more timely and trigger when leveling up
